name: FormSubmit
free_limit: Free hosted HTML form-to-email endpoints with unlimited forms and submissions; submission archive retained for 30 days and archive API access limited to 5 calls per day.
watch_out: Requires email address confirmation before use. Submission archive is retained for only 30 days; uploaded files are not accessible through the archive API. Anti-spam restrictions can affect delivery; commercial-use permission and card requirement are not explicitly established by the reviewed documentation.
